summary: Outbreak response and contact tracing are critical components of global health security. Go.Data, developed by WHO in collaboration with GOARN partners, streamlines all aspects of outbreak response and is highly versatile with customizable configurations for different scenarios. It focuses on case and contact data, generates contact follow-up lists, and visualizes chains of transmission. Go.Data is currently in use in over 60 countries and 80 institutions, primarily in low- and middle-income settings. The platform addresses the health sector, with a specific focus on disease surveillance and outbreak response. Its impact is to improve public health outcomes, particularly in resource-constrained environments.
